name: AKIRA Points, Omochi Desu ka?
original_name: あきらポイント、お持ちですか?
source:
My childhood friend suddenly came to stay at my room.
Wait, are you a woman!?

I'm at least humane enough to let you stay here for a while if you have nowhere to sleep.
Huh? You're giving me "AKIRA Point" as a token of gratitude?
OK, so what type of bonus will I get when I earn the point enough?

---- Yeah, I like the bonus.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ246918.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我儿时的朋友突然来我房间住下。
等等，你是女人吗！？

如果你没地方睡觉的话，我至少还算人道，可以让你在这里住一段时间。
啊？你给我“AKIRA积分”作为谢意？
好的，那么当我赚到足够的积分后，我会得到什么类型的奖金呢？

---- 是的，我喜欢奖金。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ246918.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
